item.title: Late Dagger Sinks Bucs Reserves - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates Reserves suffered a narrow 2-1 defeat to their Lamontville Golden Arrows counterparts in their DStv Diski Challenge fixture played at the UJ Soweto Sport Complex on Saturday morning, despite producing an energetic attacking performance.

item.title: Betway Premiership Preview: Richards Bay - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: A busy week kicks into gear for Orlando Pirates who welcome Richards Bay for a Betway Premiership clash at the Orlando Amstel Arena on Wednesday night.

item.title: Pirates Grind Past Richards Bay - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates toiled hard on their return to Orlando Amstel Arena where they ground out a 2-0 win over Richards Bay on Wednesday night’s Betway Premiership encounter.

item.title: Pirates to Compete in TST 7v7 Tournament - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates Football Club is proud to announce that it will participate in the upcoming The Soccer Tournament (TST) later this year in the United States of America.

item.title: Betway Premiership Preview: Siwelele - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates continue their hunt for more Betway Premiership points when they host Siwelele at the Orlando Amstel Arena this Saturday.

item.title: DDC Bucs Return to Winning Ways in Style - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates Reserves returned to winning ways in the DStv Diski Challenge, securing their 16th victory in 22 matches with an emphatic 5-0 win over Siwelele at a packed UJ Stadium on Saturday morning.

item.title: Pirates Foiled by Siwelele - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates slumped to a frustrating 1-1 draw in their Betway Premiership clash against Siwelele at Orlando Amstel Arena on Saturday.

item.title: Bucs Stars Set for International Duty - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates will be represented across four football nations during the upcoming FIFA international break, with several players called up for their respective national teams ahead of the fixtures that get underway later in the month.

item.title: Betway Premiership Preview: TS Galaxy - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates take their Betway Premiership campaign on the road again as they travel for a crucial clash against TS Galaxy at Mbombela Stadium on Sunday.

item.title: Ruthless Pirates Plunder Galaxy - Orlando Pirates FC
item.description: Orlando Pirates delivered a ruthless performance away to TS Galaxy, piling on the goals to walk off 6-0 victors in their Betway Premiership encounter at Mbombela Stadium on Sunday afternoon.
